description: This file contains implementation code for a Vulkan graphics sample called 'FullscreenColor'. It includes functions for creating, initializing, creating swapchain dependents, recording frames, and cleaning up Vulkan resources related to rendering a fullscreen color quad. It references external shader code and interacts with Vulkan API wrappers.

classes.name: FullscreenColor
classes.description: A class implementing a Vulkan sample that renders a fullscreen color.

methods.name: BuildVulkanSampleApp
methods.description: Builds and returns a Vulkan sample application instance for the FullscreenColor demo.

methods.name: FullscreenColor::Create
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of FullscreenColor.

methods.name: FullscreenColor::StartUp
methods.description: Initializes Vulkan resources needed for rendering.

methods.name: FullscreenColor::CreateSwapchainDependents
methods.description: Creates Vulkan objects dependent on the swapchain, such as render pass, framebuffers, and pipeline.

methods.name: FullscreenColor::RecordFrame
methods.description: Records commands to render a fullscreen color quad for a frame.
